subject: spanish
title: Lengua y Identidad
welcome_lead: Language shapes identity. Spanish unites half a billion speakers while each variety carries identity.
meta_desc: Spanish: language as identity, bilingualism, regional variation.
final_note: Each Spanish you speak is another self.

walkthroughs.body_html: El bilinguismo enriquece la mente. Spain itself is multilingual: Spanish, Catalan, Galician, Basque coexist.
Iberian Spanish (Castilian) uses vosotros; most Latin American Spanish uses ustedes. Vocabulary differs: coche (Spain) vs carro (LatAm).
Describe a photo: en la foto se ve.. Expand: esta imagen ilustra la riqueza del mundo hispanohablante.

mcqs.q: Why does 'Me gusta el chocolate' literally translate as 'Chocolate is pleasing to me'?
options: Gustar means 'to like' and works exactly like English.
It is a typo for 'Yo gusto'.
Gustar works backwards - the thing liked is the subject, the person is the indirect object.
